=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/claude_fixer_pending_checks.py | Location: evaluate() — re-read comment block around lines 533-539
  Issue: The reason string for the `review_superseded` state when the marker changed uses the original `comment_id` and a generic "no longer the live marker" phrasing. The same state fires for three distinguishable cases (a newer review posted its own marker, a newer review handed off findings with the original marker still present, or the marker was deleted entirely). An operator triaging a `pending_checks ... state=review_superseded` log line in `scripts/claude_pr_sweep.py` cannot tell which case fired without re-reading the comments.
  Suggested minimal fix: distinguish the cases in the reason string — e.g. include "marker was deleted" when `current is None` and "a newer marker comment is now live" when `current["comment_id"] != marker["comment_id"] and current is not None`. Two branches, one extra `if/else` arm.
- tests/test_claude_fixer_pending_checks.py | Location: _malformed helper around lines 195-209
  Issue: The `_DROP = object()` sentinel collides with intent: a future test that wants to assert a field explicitly holds the sentinel would silently drop the field instead. Today no test does this, but the helper is reused for every malformed-listing parametrization, so any new author will trip on it.
  Suggested minimal fix: rename `_DROP` to `_OMIT` (or guard with `if value is _DROP: run.pop(key, ...)` and document "only use to delete a key"). No runtime impact.
- scripts/claude_fixer_pending_checks.py | Location: check_review_runs(), head-branch listing URL around line 379
  Issue: `REVIEW_RUNS_PER_PAGE = 100` truncates without warning. A head branch with 100+ runs (plausible on a busy consumer repo's claude/* branch over weeks of churn) silently hides any newer-than-marker review that lives beyond the 100th row. The plan acknowledges the risk as ACCEPTED but the code emits no diagnostic, so the limit surfaces only as a confusing "older failed review must be newest?" wrong verdict if the marker itself fell off the page.
  Suggested minimal fix: after the head-branch read, if the page returned exactly 100 runs, log `pending_checks ... state=review_active ... reason=head_branch_run_listing_truncated` so an operator sees the truncation. Single `if len(branch_runs) == REVIEW_RUNS_PER_PAGE:` branch.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

  WHY: An omitted active review is absent from `active` and from `bound_reviews`. The evaluator can therefore accept the unchanged marker and enable auto-merge while that review is still running.
